newsitem.title: FINLAND: TULIKIVI SETS FIM 60 MLN INVESTMENT PLAN.
newsitem.headline: TULIKIVI SETS FIM 60 MLN INVESTMENT PLAN.

text.p: Finnish stone oven maker Tulikivi Oy said on Wednesday it had set a 60 million markka investment programme with a focus on technology improvement and export growth.
"Tulikivi Oy and its subsidiary Mittakivi Oy will in the next few years invest significantly in production technology and expansion of exports," Tulikivi said in a statement.
Mittakivi would invest 20 million markka in 1997 to 1998 and Tulikivi 40 million in 1998 to 2000, it said.
The investment programme would create 100-150 new permanent jobs, Tulikivi said, adding it now employed a staff of 212 while Mittakivi had 86 employees.

The parent company, Tulikivi, plans to build about 2,800 square metres of production facilities and add capacity for manufacturing standard ovens as well as to develop quarrying technology and capacity, Tulikivi said.
Mittakivi would obtain about 2,000 square metres of production facilities and acquire new manufacturing technology, it said.
Mittakivi's future strategy would be to focus increasingly on custom-made and small series products as well as on subcontracting and building stone production, Tulikivi said.
